title: 针对性修复 macOS desktop_multi_window 启动广播错误并更新自测用例
objective: 针对最新 macOS Release 中每次启动均出现 Invalid engine handle 与 Failed to send message to Flutter engine 的问题，完成依赖源码级根因确认、最小可验证修复或明确阻塞边界，并更新 macOS 界面自测用例。
agent_role: Codex 代码执行 agent；遵循先复现/追踪/测试后修复；仅修改允许路径；保留既有暂存改动；仅本地 commit；未经用户明确批准严禁 git push。

background.baseline: 执行前重新读取 git status、git diff --cached --name-status、git diff --name-status、git branch -vv、git log --format='%h %p %ci %s' -12；当前已知已有暂存 multi_window_manager.dart、multi_window_manager_test.dart、MACOS_ENGINE_MESSAGE_HANDOFF.json，必须保留并在其上工作。

evidence.fresh_candidate: 2026-08-31 14:34 candidate built from HEAD ce814fb plus staged multi-window fix; two startups still produced both engine-message errors.
error_tokens: Failed to send message to Flutter engine
evidence.automation_boundary: Computer Use window read and screenshot PASS; click pipe unavailable; do not infer real interaction PASS.
evidence.native_source_hypothesis: desktop_multi_window 0.3.0 macOS startup registration/notifyWindowsChanged may send on the channel before the target Engine is ready; hypothesis must be verified against dependency source.

current_code_facts: AppDelegate.swift sets FlutterMultiWindowPlugin.setOnWindowCreatedCallback, registers GeneratedPlugins for child engines, and registers file_picker_bridge on child messengers.
MainFlutterWindow.swift registers GeneratedPlugins for the main FlutterViewController.
app_bootstrap.dart initializes MultiWindowManager only on main-window path and delays showing child windows until after a frame.
MultiWindowManager already has injected MultiWindowPlatform, stale-window calibration, live-controller reuse, and show-failure liveness tests in the current staged change.
There is no permission to replace desktop_multi_window or add a new plugin dependency.

design_decisions.title: dependency_source_first
design_decisions.rationale: The failure reproduces before category interaction and names the desktop_multi_window channel; source-level dependency inspection is required before another timing workaround.
constraints: Inspect the exact installed desktop_multi_window 0.3.0 macOS implementation and registration order.
Inspect current AppDelegate/MainFlutterWindow/bootstrap order and compare with the package contract.
Do not call the issue fixed based only on Dart unit tests or process survival.
If dependency internals cannot be read, record the exact access limitation and do not guess.
acceptance: Root cause is source-confirmed, disproved, or explicitly unresolved with evidence.
The report separates startup-before-child interaction from close/show race.

design_decisions.title: minimal_fix_preserve_plugin_registration
design_decisions.rationale: Any fix must preserve main/child GeneratedPlugin registration, child file-picker channel, category reuse, close/reopen, and mobile navigation semantics.
constraints: Allowed tests: apps/flutter_forge/test/shared/multi_window_manager_test.dart and a new/updated test under apps/flutter_forge/test/shared only if the test layout contract permits it.
Do not replace desktop_multi_window, modify pubspec, add dependencies, filter error logs, or disable multi-window.
Do not alter NavigationPolicy 600dp semantics, Windows USB, Android boundaries, or responsive module code.
acceptance: Main and child plugin registration remains present.
Dart regression tests cover the changed lifecycle invariant.
No new analyzer issue or FlutterGuard HIGH is introduced.

design_decisions.title: macos_acceptance_update
design_decisions.rationale: The next real-machine run must distinguish code failures, stale artifacts, and automation-tool limitations.
constraints: Update only macos_acceptance/MACOS_SELF_TEST_CHECKLIST.md and/or a new dated evidence handoff under macos_acceptance/evidence/2026-09-01-engine-message-fix/.
Add explicit startup-only log capture, stage-by-stage three-window evidence, and MACOS_GATE/windows_ready rules.
Do not create a Windows PASS or windows_ready=true while macOS remains unresolved.
acceptance: Self-test includes startup x2, first/second/third category window, close/reopen, child file_picker, and raw-log checkpoints.
Each item has PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_IN_ARTIFACT semantics and evidence requirements.

design_decisions.title: local_only_no_push
design_decisions.rationale: The user explicitly prohibits remote push without separate approval.
constraints: Only local commit is allowed if repository permissions permit.
Do not push, tag, create Release, merge, force-push, amend prior commits, or rewrite history.
Do not include unrelated docs, pending JSON files, screenshots, build output, or old evidence in the commit.
acceptance: Commit or staged diff file list is limited to the allowed source/test/acceptance files.
If .git write permission blocks commit, leave the staged set intact and report the exact error.

implementation_steps.detail: 记录 git 状态、暂存集合、HEAD、真实 upstream；确认既有三文件暂存改动保留；读取目标 Swift/Dart、报告、清单和依赖版本。
implementation_steps.verify: 输出 baseline 与 allowed_paths；不 reset、stash、删除或覆盖无关改动。

implementation_steps.detail: 检查安装的 desktop_multi_window 0.3.0 macOS 源码，定位 AttachWindow/register/notifyWindowsChanged/channel messenger 调用链；对照 AppDelegate、MainFlutterWindow、bootstrap 的实际顺序。
implementation_steps.verify: 形成 ranked hypotheses；明确启动期错误是否来自依赖初始广播，以及应用侧可控边界。

implementation_steps.detail: 在允许测试范围内补充最小可执行回归：覆盖初始化/注册顺序或应用侧可控的 engine lifecycle invariant；保留并运行当前 stale/live/close-reopen 测试。若 native 错误无法在 Flutter test 复现，必须在报告中标 native_runtime_unavailable。
implementation_steps.verify: 先运行测试并记录真实 RED 或 already_safe；禁止以普通 Dart 测试替代原生运行证据。

implementation_steps.detail: 仅对已证实且应用侧可控的根因实施最小修复；不得过滤日志、禁用多窗口、替换依赖或靠无依据延迟掩盖错误。若根因只在依赖内部且应用侧无安全修复，保留当前正确 Dart fix，输出 BLOCKED 及下一步依赖升级/fork 决策，不杜撰代码已修复。
implementation_steps.verify: 定向测试通过；Swift/Dart 注册结构完整；git diff 无越界。

implementation_steps.detail: 更新 macOS 自测清单或新增 dated handoff：启动 x2、三分类窗口、同类复用、关闭/重开三轮、子窗口 file_picker、原始日志分阶段采集、Engine 错误 FAIL 规则、自动化点击 BLOCKED 规则、artifact provenance、MACOS_GATE 和 windows_ready 门槛。
implementation_steps.verify: 历史报告不变；新清单每项可独立 PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_IN_ARTIFACT。

implementation_steps.detail: 运行目标测试、flutter analyze、git diff --check、bash tool/quality_gate.sh；如 git 可写，仅本地提交允许文件；否则保留暂存集合并记录权限错误。绝对禁止 git push。
implementation_steps.verify: 输出测试/门禁结果、git show --name-status HEAD（若有新 commit）、git rev-parse HEAD origin/dev；远端指针不变。

acceptance_criteria: DD-1：依赖源码调用链已核对，根因结论有证据，native runtime boundary 明确
DD-2：已证实的应用侧根因得到最小修复；主/子 Engine GeneratedPlugin 与 file_picker 注册未丢失；现有 stale/live/close-reopen 测试继续通过
DD-3：macOS 自测清单/hand-off 已更新，明确真实交互证据、Engine 日志、产物身份和 Windows 前置条件
DD-4：仅本地变更；origin/dev 未变化；无 push/tag/Release/merge/history rewrite
MACOS_GATE 未被代码测试或静态首屏擅自改为 PASS；若 native runtime 仍有错误，保持 HOLD
out_of_scope: Windows 真实验收和 Windows PASS
响应式布局实现和无障碍第二阶段
Windows USB、Android host、NavigationPolicy 语义调整
替换或升级 desktop_multi_window 依赖
修改 CI、Release、tool/*.sh、pubspec、历史验收报告
删除或覆盖既有验收 evidence
forbidden_changes: 不得 git push、tag、Release、merge、force-push 或重写历史
不得过滤 Invalid engine handle 或 Failed to send message to Flutter engine 日志
不得禁用 desktop_multi_window 或删除多窗口功能
不得修改 Windows USB、Android、响应式模块或无障碍代码
不得修改 pubspec 或新增依赖
不得覆盖历史 macOS 报告或删除既有 evidence
不得将旧产物或静态截图作为新代码交互通过证据
notes: 本任务是针对性修复，不是响应式布局任务；不要扩大到其他模块。
现有 staged 三文件必须保留；如果任务新增文件，应明确分离并逐文件核对。
本机 macOS 可构建不等于真实多窗口运行已通过；若受限环境无法运行，输出 BLOCKED/native_runtime_unavailable。
远端 upstream ref 必须从 git branch -vv 实测，不得猜测。
未经用户另行明确批准，绝对禁止 git push。
